item.description: Ten Miss Samford titleholders have gone on to become Miss Alabama, and one Samford student earned the title of Miss America.

item.title: Cumberland School of Law Trial Team Finishes as National Semifinalist in Trials and Tribulations Competition
item.description: Members of Samford University Cumberland School of Law’s national trial team finished as national semifinalists in the Trials and Tribulations National Trial Competition, March 13-15, competing against 21 teams from some of the top ranked law school trial advocacy programs in the country.

item.title: Samford Alumnus Highlights Core Texts Program During Presentation at the University of Oxford
item.description: Samford University’s Core Texts program recently received international recognition when Matthew Burford, MDiv ’07, DMin ’16, was invited to present at the University of Oxford, where he highlighted the distinctive value of Samford’s approach to teaching classic works.

item.title: What Batting Average Is Missing — And How We Built Something Better
item.description: In today’s era of college baseball, nearly every pitch and every swing is tracked. Exit velocity, launch angle, and swing decisions are tracked with staggering precision, offering deeper insight into how offense is generated. And yet, despite this unprecedented level of analytic opportunity, lineup decisions are usually still made by the same familiar statistics.

item.title: Preparing for a Career in College Athletics: Carter Crum’s Legal Externship with the SEC
item.description: Carter Crum, a second-year Cumberland School of Law student, has been participating in an externship with the Southeastern Conference (SEC) this spring, benefiting from hands-on learning at the intersection of athletics, law, business and compliance.

item.title: Beeson Divinity School Celebrates Biblical Studies Lectures
item.description: Samford University’s Beeson Divinity School recently welcomed noted New Testament scholar John Barclay to campus for this year’s Biblical Studies Lectures, during which Barclay preached on the theme of "Living in the Gift."

item.title: Expanded Giving Days Campaign Advances Samford’s Bold Vision
item.description: Samford University’s annual giving campaign was a success, raising critical resources to advance scholarships, programs and operations across the university.

item.title: Bradley E. Lail Named Dean of Brock School of Business
item.description: Following a national search, Samford University has named Bradley E. Lail, PhD, CPA, dean of Brock School of Business, effective July 1, 2026.
